company.name: LeechProtocol
company.shortDescription: LeechProtocol is a decentralized finance platform that develops automated cross-chain yield aggregation for cryptocurrency users.
company.description: LeechProtocol is a decentralized finance technology company that develops an automated cross-chain yield aggregation platform that enables users to deploy cryptocurrency assets into yield farming and liquidity strategies across multiple blockchain ecosystems through a single interface. Supported blockchain networks include BNB Chain, Avalanche, Polygon, Optimism, and Arbitrum, with integrations involving decentralized exchanges and protocols such as SushiSwap, Velodrome, THENA, PancakeSwap, Curve, and Stargate.
